item.title: Election officials in Utah are leaving their jobs at a record pace. Here’s why
item.description: About half of chief election officials have left their positions since the 2020 election, mostly citing personal reasons and leaving before their term is over.

item.title: Clintons finalize agreement to testify in House Epstein probe, bowing to threat of contempt vote
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton have finalized an agreement with House Republicans to testify this month in a House investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Reports: Utah Jazz Acquiring Jaren Jackson Jr. In Massive Trade With Grizzlies
item.description: The Utah Jazz decided to shake things up in a big way ahead of the trade deadline, acquiring Jaren Jackson Jr. from Memphis for a large haul including young players and draft capital.

item.title: House passes bill to end the partial government shutdown, sending the measure to Trump
item.description: The House has passed a roughly $1.2 trillion spending package to end a partial government shutdown.

item.title: Robinson back in court as widow Erika Kirk calls for open court proceedings
item.description: Tyler Robinson is scheduled to be back in court on Tuesday.

item.title: NASA delays astronauts’ lunar trip until March after hydrogen leaks mar fueling test
item.description: NASA's long-awaited moonshot with astronauts is off until at least March because of leaking hydrogen fuel.

item.title: Paris prosecutors raid X offices as part of investigation into child abuse images and deepfakes
item.description: French prosecutors have raided the offices of social media platform X as part of an investigation into allegations of spreading child sexual abuse images and deepfakes.

item.title: Iran’s president seeks ‘fair and equitable’ negotiations, while US shoots down drone
item.description: Iran's president has instructed the foreign minister to pursue negotiations with the United States. This marks a shift amid high tensions following Iran's crackdown on protests.

item.title: Every Homeland Security officer in Minneapolis is now being issued a body-worn camera, Noem says
item.description: The secretary of Homeland Security is requiring that all the department's officers on the ground in Minneapolis wear body cameras.

item.title: Motorcyclist critically injured after crash in Murray
item.description: An adult motorcycle rider was hospitalized with critical injuries after Murray police said he was hit by a car on Tuesday afternoon.
